Explain the settlement.
See the products behind it.

Reconcile Ready plans to connect Amazon financial activity with product costs and accounting categories, so a bank deposit can be traced back to the events that produced it.

THE AMAZON SOURCE LAYER

The events behind
an Amazon payout.

The planned connection combines available settlement reporting, financial events and order detail while retaining Amazon references.

01

Orders & products

Order dates, SKUs, quantities, prices and supported tax amounts provide the product-level sales view.

02

Fees & refunds

Marketplace, fulfilment and other available charges sit alongside refunds and sales reversals.

03

Settlements

Settlement periods and payout totals connect the underlying activity with money transferred to the bank.

04

Other movements

Available reimbursements, adjustments and reserve movements explain changes that are not ordinary sales.

FROM AMAZON TO REPORTS

Keep the settlement intact.
Make every part visible.

A single transfer may contain trading activity, charges and cash movements from different dates. The review needs both the total and its components.

  1. 01
    Collect available reports and eventsPreserve account, marketplace, currency and source references.
  2. 02
    Group activity into report categoriesSeparate sales, refunds, fees, reserves and other movements.
  3. 03
    Review mappings and differencesIdentify missing data or categories before preparing entries.
  4. 04
    Prepare reviewed activity for XeroKeep final bank matching inside the accounting workflow.

PERMISSIONS & CONTROL

Authorised by the seller.
Limited to the job.

The connection will use Amazon’s Selling Partner API authorisation flow. Reconcile Ready will request only the roles required for supported financial reporting.

  • No Amazon password is shared with Reconcile Ready
  • Access can be revoked through Seller Central
  • Availability depends on approved roles, regions and reports
